Three's the real threshold, so I'm not going to reflexively say "just live with the duplication" here — that'd be ignoring my own rule.

Before I say build it though: are the three actually the same shape, or just similar? Specifically — same backoff strategy (fixed/exponential, base delay, cap, jitter or not), same max-retry count, and same set of exceptions/conditions that trigger a retry vs. bail immediately? If all three agree on those, it's a clean extraction — small function, maybe takes the callable and a config struct, done. If they disagree on more than one of those axes, you're looking at a helper with five optional params trying to cover three slightly different policies, and that's often worse than the duplication it replaces.

So: what do the three call sites actually differ on, if anything?
